description: This file defines an interface class 'IPluginStarter' for starting plugins, specifically for activating Thunder plugins with retry logic. It includes licensing information and declares a pure virtual method 'activatePlugin'.

classes.name: IPluginStarter
classes.description: Interface to start a specified plugin, with a method to activate the plugin with retries.

methods.name: activatePlugin
methods.description: Pure virtual method to activate a Thunder plugin, with parameters for maximum retries and retry delay in milliseconds.
